headline: Marvell posts a Singapore AMS verification internship for amplifier verification
fact: Marvell posted Singapore AMS Verification Intern – Master’s Degree (2604802) on September 30, 2026. The role assigns verification planning, testbench development and simulation checks for broadband amplifier circuits. Its profile requests control/feedback and automatic-gain-control knowledge; Verilog and Verilog-A are desirable programming experience, rather than explicit commitments to RNM/UVM or model generation. This Event records AMS verification recruitment, not deployed practice; unrelated lab-only validation internships are not included.
